sloka: ततस्तस्य नगस्याग्रे ह्याकाशस्थस्य दन्तिनः ।भर्त्रा परिगृहीतस्य जानकी स्कन्धमाश्रिता ।। ५.२७.१४।।।।
transliteration: tatastasya nagasyāgre hyākāśasthasya dantinaḥ ।bhartrā parigṛhītasya jānakī skandhamāśritā ।। 5.27.14।।।।

translations.english: "Then from the front of the mountain Janaki shifted to the back of the elephant held by her husband waiting in the sky.
